module: Flowgraph node 'Blacklist Parking Spots' (once_instant category). Marks as 'banned' the parking spots (gameplay_parking) located within a radius around given positions, so that parked cars do not use them, and teleports the vehicles already parked on them. Positions: posList list, pins pos_i (adjustable count) and, if 'auto', the active mission vehicles (excluding traffic/parked). The marks are removed on stop or reset.
notes: workOnce adds the positions to the posList table of the input pin (if provided), so it modifies the caller's table.
updatePins tests lnk.sourcePin whereas the pos_i pins are inputs: the links are not deleted.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

reset.desc: Removes the 'banned' tag from the spots banned by this node and clears the list.

updatePins.desc: Creates or deletes the pos_i pins.

workOnce.desc: Gathers the positions, looks for spots within the radius (default 5 m) with gameplay_parking.findParkingSpots, adds the 'banned' tag and forces the teleportation of the vehicles occupying them.

_onDeserialized.desc: Reads back count and recreates the pins.
